layout.headline: Secure access to operate secrets without exposing plaintext.
layout.description: CriptEnv keeps sign-in straightforward, but reinforces the product's most important boundary: the server only ever receives encrypted data.
layout.footnote: Protect environment variables, API keys and team credentials in a workflow built for developers.
